pages.text: Removes items from an inventory.$(br2)It removes up to $(1)count$() items and returns how many were removed. This needs allowInventoryChanges or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: the block with the inventory$(li)$(1)id$() STRING: the item ID, e.g. minecraft:rotten_flesh$(li)$(1)count$() INTEGER: the most items to remove$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the number of removed items
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/DELETE_ITEMS$(br)  PARAMETER position trashChest ;$(br)  PARAMETER id "minecraft:rotten_flesh" ;$(br)  PARAMETER count 64 ;$(br)  RESULT result removed$()
